description.en: When entering battle, Charon deals damage based on a percentage of his ATK to the farthest unit and banishes the target to the Netherworld for a period of time. The banished target temporarily leaves the battlefield, cannot act, and cannot be selected by either side.
description.zh: 登场时，卡戎对最远的单位造成基于自身攻击力一定比例的伤害，并将其驱逐至冥界，持续一段时间。被驱逐的目标会暂时离开战场，无法行动，且无法被双方选中。

level2.en: Increases the damage dealt to the target.
level2.zh: 对目标造成的伤害提升

level3.en: Extends the banish duration and additionally affects one more unit.
level3.zh: 驱逐持续时间延长，且额外对一名单位生效

level4.en: Further increases the damage dealt to the target.
level4.zh: 对目标造成的伤害再次提升

description.en: Charon channels continuously, directing a beam at the current target and dealing damage each second based on a percentage of his ATK. For every period of time the channel continues, this damage multiplier increases by a percentage, up to a cap. While channeling, Charon consumes Energy each second. If interrupted, he loses a portion of Energy.
description.zh: 卡戎持续施法，引导射线攻击当前目标，每秒对目标造成基于自身攻击力一定比例的伤害。引导每持续一段时间，该伤害倍率提升一定百分比，最多提升至一定比例；持续期间每秒消耗一定能量，若被打断则失去一定能量。

level2.en: Increases the damage dealt to the target each second.
level2.zh: 每秒对目标造成的伤害提升

level3.en: Reduces the Energy consumed each second while channeling.
level3.zh: 持续期间每秒能量消耗降低

level4.en: Further increases the damage dealt each second.
level4.zh: 每秒对目标造成的伤害再次提升

description.en: When any enemy unit approaches Charon, Charon banishes that unit for a period of time. After this effect triggers, it enters cooldown.
description.zh: 当任意敌方单位靠近卡戎时，卡戎将其驱逐一段时间。该效果触发后会进入冷却。

level4.en: When triggered, Charon gains a Shield based on a percentage of his ATK.
level4.zh: 触发时，卡戎获得基于自身攻击力一定比例的护盾

description.en: Charon slowly summons the Nether River into the mortal world. If Charon does not move for a period of time, he gains the Nether River state. Once he moves, this state is removed. While in the Nether River state, Charon deals increased damage and gains increased Lifesteal.
description.zh: 卡戎缓慢召唤冥河浮现于现世。若卡戎一段时间内没有移动，自身获得【冥河】状态；产生移动后，该状态清除。【冥河】状态下，卡戎造成的伤害提升，生命偷取提升。

level2.en: While in the Nether River state, Charon's damage dealt is further increased.
level2.zh: 【冥河】状态下，卡戎造成的伤害进一步提升

level3.en: While in the Nether River state, Charon's ATK is increased.
level3.zh: 【冥河】状态下，卡戎的攻击力提升

level4.en: While in the Nether River state, Charon's damage dealt is increased again.
level4.zh: 【冥河】状态下，卡戎造成的伤害再次提升

description.en: For every period of time Lantern Scorching Current continues channeling, its damage multiplier increases by a percentage, up to a cap.
description.zh: 提灯灼流引导每持续一段时间，伤害倍率提升一定比例，有提升上限。

level2.en: When Charon is about to die, he becomes immune to that instance of damage and briefly becomes invincible, then banishes the enemy unit that dealt that damage.
level2.zh: 当卡戎即将阵亡时，自身免疫此次伤害并进入短暂无敌，同时将造成该次伤害的敌方单位驱逐

level3.en: While in the Nether River state, Charon can become immune to a certain number of control effects.
level3.zh: 【冥河】状态下，卡戎可免疫一定次数的控制效果

level4.en: For every period of time Lantern Scorching Current continues channeling, the amount by which its damage multiplier increases is raised, and the damage multiplier cap is increased.
level4.zh: 提灯灼流引导每持续一段时间，伤害倍率增加的比例提升，伤害倍率提升的上限增加
